requirements.general_text: A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with minimum CGPA of 2.50 in a related field, as accepted by the PU Senate; OR A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a related field with CGPA of less than 2.50 and a minimum of 5 years’ working experience in the related field English Language Requirements International Students IELTS 6.0 (Equivalent to CEFR Mid B2) If a student does not meet this requirement, Perdana University will offer a three-month Intensive English Preparatory program to ensure that student's proficiency is sufficient to meet the needs of the program.
